verdict.rationale: Warp documents creating and managing API keys so the Oz CLI can authenticate agents without a human, for CI pipelines, headless servers, and containers (warp-docs-63). Separately, agent profiles restrict what an agent can access, including files, command execution, and MCP servers (warp-docs-64), and admins can set org-wide agent autonomy (warp-docs-66). However, the evidence never says the API keys themselves can be scoped or limited to least privilege; permission limits come from profiles, not the credentials. Missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permissions, key expiry or rotation controls, an explicit link between API keys and agent profiles, and independent hands-on corroboration.
